plan.title: Time-course DESeq2 LRT: treatment x time interaction genes
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is 2 conditions (treatment vs control, named per metadata) across 4 time points (t0-t3) with 3 replicates per cell (12000 genes x 24 samples counts, salmon-derived). The question — which genes change over time in a treatment-specific way, beyond the shared time trend — is exactly the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio-test (LRT) time-course design: fit the full model ~condition + time + condition:time and compare it against the reduced model ~condition + time. Genes significant in this LRT have a time trajectory that differs by condition, independent of any trend shared by both arms. The plan runs QC first (checking sample structure/outliers before trusting the model), pre-filters minimally, fits the interaction LRT, shrinks fold changes for reporting, applies BH-adjusted significance, clusters/visualizes the significant genes' trajectories to characterize the interaction pattern, and runs pathway enrichment on the ranked interaction statistic. Every step is grounded in the returned bulk-rna-seq time-course procedure (snapshot sha256:833150c...). Power caveat: n=3 per cell is a genuinely small design for detecting an interaction (a difference of differences); the plan states this explicitly per rule R-0017 and does not loosen thresholds to compensate.
